text.description_html:
Kwikset 966DNL, Single Cylinder Dorian Replacement Interior Trim

This is a Interior Trim Replacement with Dorian Lever. The Dorian Lever Single Cylinder Interior Trim delivers elegant style by evoking a sense of the past. With traditional style, the Kwikset 966DNL Dorian Lever with Thumbturns is a great addition to classic homes.

Features and Specifications of the Kwikset Dorian Lever Interior Trim Set:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Lever Length: 3.75"
  • Lever Projection: 2-7/18"
  • Deadbolt to Latch Spacing: 5-1/2" center to center
  • Non-handed levers
  • Concealed screws.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
